stories.title: Man dies after crash involving car and HGV
stories.summary: Police say the collision happened on the M180 at about 12:00 GMT on Thursday.

stories.title: Illegal cigarette plant could make 200,000 a day
stories.summary: The processing plant was uncovered at an industrial site in Bourne, Lincolnshire.

stories.title: Future of Grade I-listed windmill to be discussed
stories.summary: Lincolnshire County Council says it is "not financially viable" to look after its four windmills.

stories.title: Mystery over bark-stripped trees in park
stories.summary: Vandals, dog owners or even deer could be behind damage to trees in a Haverstoe Park, Cleethorpes.

stories.title: Tribute to 'loving dad' killed in M18 horse crash
stories.summary: Johnny Brown's family is "devastated" after his death following a crash with a horse on the M18.

stories.title: Town hopes Elton John is still standing by his song in bid for support
stories.summary: Grimsby is trying to get the superstar, who sang about the town, to support its Town of Culture bid.

stories.title: Restrictions in place after another bird flu case
stories.summary: An exclusion zone is in place after avian influenza is found in commercial poultry near Coningsby.

stories.title: Food banks facing 'critically low' donation levels
stories.summary: Four in 10 Yorkshire and northern Lincolnshire food banks say the situation is getting worse.

stories.title: Thousands of Santas taking part in festive fun runs
stories.summary: Santas will fill the streets of Lincoln, Louth, Boston, Grantham, Scunthorpe, Skegness and Hull.

stories.title: 'This is my last shot at finding missing brother'
stories.summary: Madeline Judd, 79, is issuing a final appeal to find her brother who went missing 30 years ago.

stories.title: Plan to buy homes for homeless and cut hotel use
stories.summary: City of Lincoln Council says it spends £500k a year on short-term accommodation to help homeless.

stories.title: Hit-and-run driver jailed for three years
stories.summary: A 46-year-old man crossing the road was left with serious life-changing injuries, police say.
